title: Flutter Developer
description:
Key Responsibilities

* Develop and maintain mobile applications using **Flutter** and **Dart**.
* Implement **state management** solutions (GetX preferred).
* Build **responsive UIs** that adapt to multiple screen sizes and devices.
* Integrate and manage **RESTful APIs** with JSON parsing and efficient network handling.
* Publish and update applications on the **Google Play Store** and **Apple App Store**.
* **Debug and troubleshoot** application errors, ensuring smooth performance.
* Research, evaluate, and integrate **third\-party packages** to solve development challenges.
* Follow **clean code practices** and apply relevant design patterns (MVC, MVVM).
* Write and maintain **unit tests and widget tests** to ensure code quality.
* Work with **Android and iOS native workflows**, including platform channels and integrations.
* Implement and manage **push notifications** (Firebase Cloud Messaging \& local notifications).

Required Skills \& Qualifications :

* Required **1 year of experience**.
* Strong proficiency in **Dart programming fundamentals** (loops, conditionals, syntax).
* **Solid experience with Flutter framework for cross\-platform development.**
* **Hands\-on experience in publishing apps to Google Play and App Store.**
* **Familiarity with mobile app lifecycle, performance optimization, and debugging.**
* **Understanding of state management techniques, preferably GetX.**
* **Knowledge of REST APIs, authentication mechanisms, and secure data handling.**
* **Strong grasp of design patterns and clean architecture principles.**
* **Ability to write testable code and perform unit/widget testing.**
* **Familiarity with native Android \& iOS workflows and integrations.**
* **Good problem\-solving, analytical, and communication skills.**

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: ₹12,000\.00 \- ₹15,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: QA Lead
description:
Position: QA Lead  
**Budget:** Up to ₹70k – ₹80k  
**Experience:** 6 years

Interested Candidate can share cv on **unnati@addact.net**

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead and mentor the QA team, assigning tasks and reviewing test deliverables.
* Define and implement QA strategy, test plans, and test cases for web and mobile applications.
* Own the end\-to\-end testing lifecycle including functional, regression, integration, performance, and UAT testing.
* Design and maintain automation testing frameworks and scripts (Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, etc.).
* Collaborate with project managers, developers, and business analysts to understand requirements and define acceptance criteria.
* Set up and manage test environments and test data.
* Track, log, and manage defects through to resolution using bug\-tracking tools (JIRA, Azure DevOps).
* Drive process improvements to increase testing efficiency and product quality.
* Leverage AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, etc.) for test case generation, automation scripting, and reporting.
* Prepare and present QA metrics, test reports, and release readiness status to stakeholders.
* Ensure compliance with quality standards and best practices across projects.

**Required Skills \& Experience**

* 6\+ years of experience in software QA, with at least 1\-2 years in a lead/senior role.
* Strong knowledge of manual and automation testing methodologies.
* Hands\-on experience with test automation tools (Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, or similar).
* Experience with API testing tools (Postman, RestAssured).
* Solid understanding of SDLC, STLC, and Agile/Scrum methodologies.
* Experience with bug\-tracking and test management tools (JIRA, TestRail, Azure DevOps).
* Strong knowledge of SQL for backend/database validation.
* Mandatory working knowledge of AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, etc.) for day\-to\-day work.
* Strong communication and leadership skills, with strong stakeholder management ability.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.

**Good to Have**

* Experience with performance testing tools (JMeter, LoadRunner).
* Exposure to CI/CD integration of automated test suites.
* Knowledge of mobile app testing (iOS/Android) and cross\-browser testing.
* Familiarity with e\-commerce/Shopify platform testing.
* Certifications such as ISTQB.

Pay: ₹800,000\.00 \- ₹1,000,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Android App Developer
description:
We are looking for a skilled Android App Developer with 1\-2 years of experience to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining Android applications that meet the needs of our users and clients. You will collaborate with cross\-functional teams to define, design, and ship new features, and work on bug fixing and improving application performance.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


* Design and Build: Develop high\-quality Android applications using Java and Android SDK.
* Collaborate: Work closely with product managers, designers, and other developers to build intuitive, user\-friendly apps.
* Maintain: Monitor and optimize app performance, ensuring the apps run smoothly and efficiently.
* Testing: Write unit tests and check to ensure app quality.
* Deploy: Manage the release of applications.
* Stay Updated: Keep up with the latest industry trends and technologies to ensure our applications remain cutting\-edge.

**Skills and Qualifications**
-----------------------------


* Experience: 1\-2 years of professional experience in Android app development.
* Proficiency: Strong knowledge of Java and Android SDK.
* Tools: Familiarity with Android tools and other development tools.
* UI/UX: Basic understanding of UI/UX principles, Material Design, and experience with RESTful APIs.
* Problem\-Solving: Strong analytical skills and the ability to troubleshoot issues effectively.
* Team Player: Good communication skills and the ability to work well within a team environment.

**Educational Qualifications**
------------------------------


* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

**Preferred Skills**
--------------------


* Experience with third\-party libraries and APIs.
* Familiarity with cloud message APIs and push notifications.
* Experience with continuous integration and automated testing tools.

**Soft Skills**
---------------


* Strong problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and teamwork abilities.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment.
* Eagerness to learn new technologies and continuously improve.

title: Android developer
description:
###### **Code the next innings of CricHeroes on Android.**
Cricket connects millions, and CricHeroes brings that connection to life through technology.


Our Android app is where cricketers record matches, track stats, and celebrate their performances. With millions of downloads, it’s already making waves, but we’re just getting started.


That’s where you come in.


###### **The challenge**
We’re looking for an Android Developer who’s passionate about building high performance apps and learning fast.


You’ll work with our product and engineering teams to create smooth, scalable, and intuitive experiences that bring grassroots cricket closer to the digital world.


###### **Your mission?**
Turn everyday matches into unforgettable experiences, powered by clean code and creative problem solving.


###### **What we’re looking for**


* Fresher with a strong interest in Android development.
* Strong knowledge of Kotlin. Java familiarity is a plus.
* Hands on experience with Android Studio, XML layouts, and Material Design guidelines.
* Understanding of RESTful APIs, JSON, and SQLite data storage mechanisms.
* Familiarity with MVVM architecture, Jetpack Components, and version control tools like Git.
* Curiosity to explore new technologies and experiment with modern Android libraries.

A team player who values clean, readable, and maintainable code.  
* 

###### **What you’ll do**


* Collaborate with designers and backend developers to build new features for the CricHeroes Android app.
* Write efficient, testable, and reusable Kotlin code.
* Debug issues, optimize performance, and ensure app stability across devices.
* Participate in code reviews and continuously learn from the team.

Contribute ideas to improve user experience and app quality.  
* 

###### **About CricHeroes**
CricHeroes is the world’s largest cricket network with 50\+ million users worldwide. We help local cricketers showcase their talent, get recognition, and improve their game using data and technology.


We believe in fewer rules, more ownership, and loads of candour. You’ll join a young, collaborative team that loves building products that make grassroots cricket unforgettable.


If this sounds like your kind of challenge, we’d love to hear from you.


If this sounds like your kind of challenge then\-


  
Join our team and change the way cricket is played forever. Please send your resume to talent@cricheroes.in
